text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Today's your birthday, isn't it? Spe and 
the others are preparing a celebration, so 
you'd better keep your schedule open.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah—... It's not like I'm a kid anymore, 
just the thought is enough for a birthday 
party...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really. Well then, I'll go tell 
everyone that it's being called off.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wha... Y-You went through all the trouble 
to prepare it, so how the heck could I 
turn it down?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... If you wanted to be celebrated, 
stop trying to act cool and just say so. 
Good grief, you're so stubborn.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? I'm always honest with 
myself!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haaah—!? Then why don't you try 
congratulating me honestly for once!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hah, happy birthday! You're not a kid 
anymore, so how about learning to calm 
down a little?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What part of that is honest?! You stubborn 
contrarian!!
